rule_description: This automation allows you to toggle your WeMo Smart Plug on or off by clicking your Flic button. Specifically, whenever you press the Flic, whether it's a single click, double click, or a hold, the WeMo Smart Plug will switch to the opposite state (if it's on, it will turn off; if it's off, it will turn on).

name: If current temperature drops below specific level, turn off A/C
description: Automatically turn off your A/C if the outside temperature drops below a specific level you decide.
rule_description: This automation monitors your local temperature and will automatically turn off your air conditioning unit whenever the outside temperature drops below a specified level that you set. It checks the current temperature in both Fahrenheit and Celsius, along with the weather conditions, ensuring your A/C system runs efficiently only when needed.
user_intent_example: Please turn off the A/C automatically when the outdoor temperature falls below 60°F, especially in the evenings.

name: Remind me to charge my Android device

name: Pic to moto
description: Pictures to moto 360

name: shut off lights on the hour

name: If new contact added, then create new contact

rule_description: This automation triggers whenever a new contact is added to your address book. name: Average Price Change - Honeywell - Part 1: Set Honeywell Thermostat when price is high

Whenever the price exceeds my threshold, set my Honeywell thermostat.

name: Charging battery

name: Upper level AC
